Group rides in South Carolina

9 recurring group rides around South Carolina: 8 road, 2 social. 4 roll on weeknights, 4 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Rock Hill Bicycle Club Slow Spokes in Rock Hill — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Social Fun Sunday runs 14–18 mph.
